summary: Legacy query param escaping causes dashboard widget to render empty for some saved views
description:
Issue summary: Several saved dashboard widgets show as empty (no series) when the underlying saved view contains legacy-style URL-encoded query params (percent-encoded commas and pipe chars). Impact: Customer Nimbus Games (enterprise) reports multiple dashboards used in on-call rotation are blank leading to monitoring blindspots. Environment: prod us-east and reproducer in eu-west.

Observed behavior: The dashboard panel makes an explore API call where the saved view's query param 'route=events%2Ctransactions' is double-decoded during retention-tier migration, resulting in the server treating it as two separate routes and returning no series.

Contact/Context: Reported via support@ and #support slack thread (link: https://slack.redwood/support/threads/CLD1234).
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Login as Nimbus Games org user with saved dashboard that references a saved view using legacy query param encoding.
2) Open the saved dashboard panel (time range last 30m).
3) Observe the panel status; open Network tab and inspect the explore request querystring.
4) Note the route= parameter is not percent-encoded and the server returns an empty series response.
5) Switch tenant retention tier to 'compact-archive' to reproduce migration behavior.
expected_result: Saved dashboard panels should correctly preserve and encode legacy query parameters and return the expected time series without requiring manual re-saving of the saved view.
actual_result: Panels render empty. The explore API returns a 200 with an empty 'series' payload and a warning header 'x-query-parse-warning: ambiguous-route-splitting'. The console shows 'No data' in the UI.
logs:
[2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] explore-service: request id=req-9b2a route=events%2Ctransactions org=nim-games saved_view_id=sv-183
[2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] query-parser: warning req-9b2a decoded_route='events,transactions' (split_count=2) normalized_route_list=[events,transactions]
[2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] ingest-retention: migration=compact-archive job=evict-prefix start
[2026-03-10T14:02:12Z] explore-service: response req-9b2a status=200 series_count=0 headers="x-query-parse-warning: ambiguous-route-splitting"
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: a parsing change in query-service 2.8.0 introduced an automatic split on commas in decoded route strings. This interacts poorly with legacy saved views where commas were percent-encoded to represent a single composite route identifier. Reproduced locally by creating a saved view with 'route=events%2Ctransactions' and confirming the query-parser emits split_count=2 when retention-tier migration is active.

Correlation: Related to recent retention-tier compact/archival work (rollout on 2026-03-09) and a pruning job that rehydrates saved views to a normalized format. No errors in Sentry; behavior is deterministic. Tentative mitigation: ensure quote-preserving decode or treat percent-encoded commas as literal when seen in saved_view context. Linked to code PR attempt in staging: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7890 which adds preserved_decode(saved_view=true).

Next steps: 1) Add unit tests for saved view decoding. 2) Backport fix to 2.8.x for dedicated and hosted customers. 3) Provide workaround steps to customer (resave impacted saved views).
customer_comments: Customer note (from Nimbus Games CS): "This affects three dashboards our SREs rely on during peak hours. We can resave but need a safer automated path for 150+ saved views. Please advise on bulk remediation and ETA for patch."
support_comments: Support triage: Assigned to Arjun Patel. Triage note: high operational impact for enterprise customer but scoped to saved-views with legacy encoding. Escalated to infra and query-parser owner. Notified SRE and remediation options discussed in #support-ops. Recommended temporary workaround: resave dashboards or use URL encode wrappers. Logged as possible rollback candidate for the retention migration if widespread.
resolution: Investigating - temporary workaround provided (resave saved views). Patch PR opened and pending review. No customer-impacting rollback yet.
resolution_notes: Patch to treat percent-encoded delimiters in saved views as literals merged to staging branch; backport in progress. When fix is rolled, a bulk-migration script will run to update saved views for enterprise customers who opt-in. Customer informed and awaiting ETA for backport deployment.
